changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingconfiguration AS SELECT bc.id, bc.facility_id, bc.configuration_key, bc.value_type, bc.configuration_value, bc.enum_code, bc.description, bc.active, bc.status, bc.created_by, bc.created_date, bc.last_modified_by, bc.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_configuration bc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingconfiguration TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingconfiguration FROM report_user;
